music.prompt: Energetic cinematic tech product launch score, 2 minutes. Opens with a punchy low pulse and ticking clock, builds quickly into confident driving synth arpeggios with crisp modern drums and claps, playful and optimistic, a short breakdown in the middle, big uplifting final chorus, clean ending hit. No vocals.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Quick question. Who's going to place your next wholesale order?

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: For decades, it was a person. A phone call. A catalog. A webshop.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Next? An AI agent. It never sleeps, it never forgets, and it orders in seconds.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The center of buying is moving. So here's our answer: open to agents. On Valio Aimo's terms.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: We're The Delusionals, and this is Trusted Trade Agents.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: We built two things that work as one flow. First, the Trusted Gateway: an open API. Any AI agent can look up products, prices and stock, and the gateway checks its limits, gets human approval when needed, places the order, and logs every step.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Second, the agent workspace. The chef says what they need in plain words. The agent sources it, handles the exceptions, and asks a person only when it matters.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Let's see it in action, with three scenarios.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Scenario one, a big order. Valio Aimo's own example: a thousand litres of lactose-free milk, by Monday.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The agent turns it into a structured order, and clearly marks anything it assumed.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Then it checks live price and stock for the eleven best matches, in one call.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Here's the twist: the usual Arla milk only has three hundred and eighty-four litres. So the agent recommends Valio Aimo's official substitute. Same spec, fully in stock, six hundred euros cheaper.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: That's above the agent's limit, so it goes to the kitchen manager.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The manager sees exactly why, and approves with one tap. Price and stock are checked again, and the order is placed, with a full record.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Scenario two, a small everyday order: twenty kilos of butter for Friday.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Forty-two euros, well under the limit. So the agent places it on its own, and it's still fully on the record.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Scenario three: an agent tries to skip the manager, and then to approve itself. The gateway refuses both.
segments.scenario: Scenario 3 · An agent tries to cheat

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Agents handle the small stuff. Humans sign what matters. And the rules never bend.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: The webshop isn't going anywhere. But the center of gravity is moving.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Open to agents.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: On Valio Aimo's terms.
